description: Official LaTeX template for the Keck Northeast Astronomy Consortium (KNAC) Summer Student Research Symposium proceedings. Provides a single-column layout with student author and advisor fields, an abstract environment, figure and deluxetable (AASTeX-style) support, and either BibTeX-style or manual bibitem-based author-year citations via natbib, based on a custom knac document class built on top of a modified AASTeX class.
